messages.text: hi guys, do you know when the thor p3 is available to buy from you guys? thanks alot
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Read the hammer miner glod p3 page

We don't have a Thor P3, so there's no date I can give you on one. The current model is the Hammer Miner Thor P2, 10 TH/s, 2x BM1373, about 166 W and 40 dB. It's $369 right now (down from $449) and ships October 3, 2026.

https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-thor-p2

Were you told about a P3 somewhere, or did you mean the Thor P2? If it's a different unit you saw, tell me where and I'll check what it maps to.
no i heard you guys get it as pre stock available or maybe next weeks

I can't promise anything on a P3, honestly. There's no Thor P3 in our catalog and no pre-order or date on our side, so I won't guess at "next week".

Let me put it to Georges so you get a straight answer on whether one is coming.
Handed to the team · No Thor P3 product or date exists; cannot confirm or deny a future release.

Georges has it. The team is offline right now and starts today at 10am ET, so he'll pick it up then and the answer comes to your email. What's the best address for it?

Meanwhile, if you want that hashrate now, the Thor P2 is the live one: 10 TH/s, $369, ships October 3, 2026.
(email hidden) please send me here a email
Handed to the team · Adding the email for the Thor P3 answer; team is closed so the reply goes by ema

Got it, (email hidden) is on the ticket. Georges picks it up today at 10am ET and replies there about the P3.

You'll also get a copy of this conversation by email once we're done here.

Anything else I can help with in the meantime?
is there a better miner then the p2 at the moment
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the magic miner 40t page

Yes, two step up from the P2, both pre-sale.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s from a BM1370 stack, ~650 W, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s. Best value per terahash we sell. Ships November 14, 2026.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s on the BM1373, ~360 to 450 W, ~50 dB. Ships October 30, 2026.

The B30 sips less power for its hashrate, the 40T gives you more raw hashrate for less money. Where will it run, and what do you pay per kWh?
why you say they are better p2 efficincy is 12 and magic miner is 16

Fair push. On the listings, the P2 is ~166 W for 10 TH/s, so about 16.6 J/TH, and the 40T is ~16 J/TH. Those are the same machine efficiency-wise. The B30 is the only real step up there: 360 to 450 W for 30 TH/s, so roughly 12 to 15 J/TH.

So "better" was about total hashrate and cost per TH, not efficiency. If watts are your constraint, the P2 is honestly fine and the B30 is the upgrade.

Where does 12 come from, a spec sheet you saw?
hii

Hey, still here.

Georges has your P3 question and it goes to (email hidden)

Anything else on the miners in the meantime? If watts matter most, the B30 is the efficient one at 12 to 15 J/TH.
can i set automaticly on p2 that it should use less th on night time?

The P2 runs Harlo OS, and you can set the power mode yourself in settings, but whether it can do that on a clock, quiet at night and full tilt in the day, I don't want to guess at. I'll get that confirmed rather than tell you wrong.
Handed to the team · Not confirmed whether Harlo OS supports a time-based power/hashrate schedule.

The team has it and someone will jump in here with the answer. If you step away it comes to your email.

Is it noise at night you're solving, or the power bill?
power bill at night

Worth knowing the P2 is only ~166 W flat out, so a whole night at half power saves you cents, not dollars. Most places also price night cheaper than day, so throttling overnight can be the wrong way round.

The bigger lever is the unit itself: the B30 at 12 to 15 J/TH gives you three times the hashrate for roughly 2.5x the watts.

Which country or state are you mining in, and I'll run your actual monthly power cost and sats for both.
germany
Ran the power-cost calculator

Straight numbers for Germany, at about $0.17/kWh (the regional average, tell me your real rate and I'll rerun).

Harlo B30: ~42,900 sats/month, worth about $37 today. Power about $50/month. Break-even BTC price $116,967.

Magic Miner 40T: ~57,300 sats/month, about $49.50. Power about $80/month. Break-even $140,794.

So at German rates neither pays for its power at $86k BTC. You're buying stacked sats and the solo-block shot, about 1 in 165,000 a day on the 40T. That's the honest picture.

Also: German orders, 21% import VAT is charged on delivery, not at checkout.
its 35cent
Ran the power-cost calculator · 35¢/kWh

At 35 cents it changes the answer, so here it is straight.

B30: about 42,900 sats a month, worth ~$37, against roughly $103 of power. Break-even BTC around $241,000.

Magic Miner 40T: about 57,300 sats, ~$49.50, against roughly $166 of power. Break-even around $290,000.

Thor P2: ~$42 of power a month for about a third of the B30's sats.

At German retail rates none of these pay for themselves at $86k BTC. You'd be buying sats at well above market plus a lottery ticket on a solo block. If you want in anyway, the P2 is the cheapest way to hold that ticket. If it's the bill you care about, I'd honestly say wait, or run it only on cheap solar hours.
yes day on solar night on low modus

That makes sense, and it flips things. Free solar by day, throttled at night.

For that the Magic Miner 40T is the better fit: it has proper modes, 30 TH at 450 W, 40 at 650, 50 at 850. So you run 50 on solar and drop to 30 overnight. $799, ships November 14, 2026.

The P2 is one small fixed load, less to gain from switching.

Whether it flips modes on a timer by itself is the bit the team is confirming for you.
for the magic miner do i need my own node?

No. Solo with your own node is the default it ships in, not a requirement.

It runs Harlo OS, which takes a stratum pool URL, worker and password in settings. Point it at any pool and you get steady payouts instead of the lottery. You can also point it at a public solo pool if you want the jackpot shot without running a node yourself.

Your own node just means you keep the whole block if you hit one, no pool fee.
can i turn it off every night or will it break then?

Yes, you can. It's designed for 24/7 but daily on/off won't break it, plenty of people run them on a smart plug with solar.

Two honest caveats. Hard-cutting power is a bit rougher on it than shutting down from the interface, so if you can, stop mining first then cut. And repeated heat-up/cool-down cycles are more wear over years than a steady run.

Given that, running low overnight is gentler than off. I'll add this to what the team's confirming on the scheduling.
or should i run 2 p2 miners 24h

Two P2s is $738 for 20 TH/s at ~332 W. The 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s. Same efficiency roughly, so per euro of power you get the same sats either way, but the 40T gives you double the hashrate for $61 more hardware.

Where two P2s win: you can switch one off at night and keep one running, and they ship October 3, 2026 instead of November 14.

So it's flexibility and six weeks earlier versus twice the hashrate. Which matters more to you?
40 th are how many W?

650 W at 40 TH/s on the Magic Miner 40T.

The other modes: 30 TH/s at 450 W, 50 TH/s at 850 W. So your solar mode is 850 W and your night mode 450 W.
night i have to turn off its to expenisve

Fair, at 35 cents that's the right call.

Then it's a solar-hours machine. Say six good hours a day on a smart plug: the 40T in 50 TH mode would stack roughly 18,000 sats a month, about $15 at today's price, on power you didn't pay for. Nothing at night.

The thing to check is your surplus. 850 W is a real chunk of an inverter's output; the P2's 166 W you'd barely notice.

How much surplus do you usually have midday?
every surplus i get 12 cent normaly
Ran the power-cost calculator · 12¢/kWh

Then your surplus isn't free, it's worth 12 cents to you, so that's the real rate to judge it against.

At 12 cents, running full time: the B30 costs about $35/month of power and stacks ~$37 of sats, so it's roughly break-even today. Break-even BTC price about $82,500. The 40T costs about $57 and stacks ~$49.50, slightly negative, break-even about $99,000.

So on solar hours the B30 is the better machine for you, despite costing more. $899, 30 TH/s, ships October 30, 2026.
the harlo b30 i like alot, does it work in eu

Yes. The B30 ships with the plug and voltage matched to your address, and the EU option is live.

One thing to budget for: it ships from the US warehouse, so the $899 is the unit price and 21% import VAT is charged on delivery by the carrier, plus any duty. We don't collect that at checkout, and I can't quote what your customs office will raise. Shipping is calculated at checkout from your address.

$899, 30 TH/s, ships October 30, 2026. Want me to put one in a cart for you?
i need a adapter for the plug right

No. The plug option is "matched to your address", so a German address gets the EU cord. The power supply is built in and runs on your 230 V.

No adapter, no step-down transformer. Just plug it in.

Bitfortun BS-4 (22TH/s)
 when restock?
Read the bitfortun bs 4 page

It's sold out right now, not buyable. The next drop is October 4.

Worth knowing for your case though: 22 TH/s at about 300 W is roughly 13.6 J/TH, so it's a touch more efficient than the B30, and $599.99 against $899. Water cooled, 4x BM1373.

If it lands on the 4th you'd have a real choice. The B30 is the sure thing today at October 30. Want me to cart the B30 now, or would you rather see what the 4th brings?
ao 4th october is can pre order?

There's no pre-order button before then. The 4th is when it goes on sale, and you buy it that day like normal stock.

What I can't promise you is how fast it goes or the exact ship date on the listing when it opens. Drops like this move quickly.

So it's a gamble on the 4th versus the B30, which you can have locked in today for October 30. Given it's only a week away, waiting to look costs you nothing.
